policies.title: Returns & refunds
policies.content: Unopened, sterile-sealed instruments can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method. Installed or used devices, custom items, and opened consumables cannot be returned unless faulty. Refunds post within 5 business days of the return reaching our warehouse. ACME Dental members get free return pickup for devices; otherwise use the prepaid label in your order page.

policies.title: Shipping options & timelines
policies.content: Standard shipping is ¥60, free over ¥500, and arrives in 3-5 business days. Express arrives in 2 business days and is free for ACME Dental members on orders over ¥500, otherwise ¥120. Same-day delivery is available on eligible consumables in select areas when ordered before 2pm. Large equipment such as treatment chairs and imaging units ships freight and includes a scheduled delivery window.

policies.title: Price match promise
policies.content: If you find an identical, in-stock instrument at a lower price from an authorised dealer within 14 days of purchase, we will match it and refund the difference. Auctions, clearance, and marketplace sellers are excluded. Contact support with a link to the competing listing.

policies.title: Warranties & protection plans
policies.content: Manufacturer warranties apply to all devices; the duration is listed on the product page under specs. ACME Care plans extend coverage to 3 years and include annual calibration checks on handpieces and motors. Claims are handled in-app and most replacements ship within 2 business days of approval.

policies.title: ACME Dental membership
policies.content: ACME Dental membership costs ¥790/year and includes free express shipping over ¥500, free device return pickup, early access to seasonal promotions, and 2% back in store credit on consumables. You can cancel anytime and we will prorate the unused portion. There is a 14-day free trial for new members.

policies.title: Gift cards
policies.content: Digital gift cards are delivered by email within minutes and never expire. Physical gift cards ship free. Gift cards cannot be redeemed for cash except where required by law, and cannot be used to buy other gift cards. Check your balance any time in the app under Payments.

policies.title: Changing or cancelling an order
policies.content: Orders can be modified or cancelled within 30 minutes of being placed from the order page. After that, items that have not entered the packing process can still be cancelled — contact support. Once an order has shipped, use the return process instead. Delivery-address changes after shipping are handled by the carrier and are not guaranteed.

policies.title: Damaged or missing items
policies.content: If an item arrives damaged or an order is missing items, report it within 7 days from the order page with a photo. We will send a replacement or refund the affected items — no need to return the damaged product unless we send a pickup label. Claims are reviewed case by case after the carrier confirms delivery.

policies.title: Buying guide: choosing a dental handpiece
policies.content: Start with the procedure mix. A high-speed turbine handles cavity preparation and crown reduction; look at rpm (around 400,000 is standard), head size for posterior access, and whether it is autoclavable. A low-speed handpiece covers polishing, finishing and slow preparation, usually with a 4-hole or ISO connection — match it to your unit. LED lighting helps in deep cavities. For surgery or implant work choose a dedicated surgical or implant angle with the right connection and torque range. Autoclavability and bearing type matter more than brand for daily reliability.

policies.title: Buying guide: choosing a curing light
policies.content: Match the wavelength to your composites: most materials cure in the 420-480 nm band, while bulk-fill and some universal composites need a wider range such as 385-515 nm. Output power around 1000-1500 mW/cm2 with an even beam shortens cure time and reduces the risk of an under-cured restoration. Check the number of presets, the light-guide diameter, and battery life for a full clinic day. A narrow guide reaches tight contact areas; a broad guide cures large surfaces faster.

policies.title: Buying guide: intraoral scanners and imaging
policies.content: For an intraoral scanner, accuracy and full-colour capture matter most for crowns and aligners; a heated tip keeps the field clear, and wireless freedom helps around the chair. For radiography, a high-frequency DC unit gives sharper, lower-dose images than an AC unit. CBCT is for implant planning and 3D diagnosis: choose the field of view to match your cases rather than buying the largest, and check whether the unit offers a 2D panoramic mode.
